note: BBVA México's Cuenta Libretón Básico carries an administration fee of 62 pesos a month before VAT (71.92 with Mexico's 16%), reduced to nothing in a month with four card withdrawals or fewer under a promotion; the game doesn't count card withdrawals, so it charges the fee. Read again 2026-10-30 with the contract's cover sheet and the general tariff (October 2026): the account pays no interest ("SIN INTERESES"); it opens with no initial deposit and no opening fee; a Mexican opens it with a current voter card (INE) and proof of address under three months old, a foreigner with a passport, a current migration form or residence card and proof of address (the form holds one list: the citizen's is written). The tariff prices an SPEI transfer by internet banking at $5.00 and an international SWIFT transfer at 20 USD, but its digital-services table also lists same-day SPEI at $0.00 for some products without a legible column for this one, and the 20 USD isn't in pesos, so neither transfer is written. Withdrawals abroad and at other networks' machines are charged by the machine's owner, not by BBVA. Not stated: overdraft (the account has no checkbook; the overdraft penalty in the tariff is for cheques), a returned payment, a share on another currency.
